content.text: Applying the chosen actions: fetch origin, replace the conflicting binary with origin/master’s version, continue an ongoing rebase (or rebase local master onto origin/master), then push with --force-with-lease. Running these commands now and will show results.

input.command:
cd /home/paul/Documents/projects/gameideas || exit 1
set -e
FILE="uigames/archive/hero_adventure/dev_guide.epub"
echo "FETCH origin..."
git fetch origin --quiet

echo "Checking for in-progress rebase/merge..."
if [ -d .git/rebase-apply ] || [ -d .git/rebase-merge ] || [ -f .git/MERGE_HEAD ]; then
  echo "Rebase/merge in progress. Trying to use remote version for $FILE"
  if git checkout --theirs -- "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Checked out --theirs for $FILE"
  else
    echo "--theirs failed; checking out origin/master version"
    git checkout origin/master -- "$FILE"
  fi
  git add "$FILE"
  echo "Staging $FILE and attempting to continue rebase/merge..."
  # Try rebase continue first
  if git rebase --continue; then
    echo "git rebase --continue succeeded"
  else
    echo "git rebase --continue failed or not applicable; trying git merge --continue"
    git merge --continue || echo "merge --continue also not applicable or failed"
  fi
else
  echo "No rebase/merge in progress. Replacing $FILE with origin/master version and committing."
  git checkout origin/master -- "$FILE"
  git add "$FILE"
  if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
    git commit -m $'Resolve conflict: use origin/master version of uigames/archive/hero_adventure/dev_guide.epub

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>'
  else
    echo "No staged changes to commit."
  fi
  echo "Rebasing local master onto origin/master..."
  git checkout master || true
  git rebase origin/master
fi

echo "Attempting push to origin (force-with-lease)..."
if git push --force-with-lease origin master:master; then
  echo "Push succeeded."
else
  echo "Push failed. Exiting with status 0 but please inspect output above."
fi

echo "--- final status ---"
git status --porcelain=2 -b || git status -b

echo "--- branches ---"
git branch -vv

echo "--- recent commits ---"
git log --oneline -n 30
